patch.objective: Managing VPC firewall rules and Cloud NGFW policies day-to-day

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Associate Cloud Engineer exam guide (PDF linked from the certification page): setting up a cloud solution environment (~20%), planning and implementing a cloud solution (~30%), ensuring the successful operation of a cloud solution (~30%), configuring access and security (~20%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-18. Four sections with the weights above match the course seed's units; subsections 3.3 'Managing networking resources' and 4.2 'Managing service accounts'; the guide names CMEK (3.2), Query Insights (3.4) and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (2.1, 3.1). The HTML page at cloud.google.com/certification/guides/cloud-engineer/ still shows an older five-section outline (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run for Anthos); the PDF is the current guide.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Connectivity Tests: Reasons for dropped test packets
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: 'Dropped due to a firewall rule': a test packet can be denied by a blocking VPC firewall rule or firewall policy rule; a higher-priority deny is a possible cause; the result is a configuration analysis ('the actual data plane might allow the packet through due to connection tracking'). That hierarchical firewall policies are evaluated before VPC firewall rules, the goto_next action, and the result's naming of the policy and priority are from memory of the Cloud NGFW pages (to verify).
